verses.text: A song for going up to worship. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be shaken. It stands firm forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, the LORD surrounds his people now and forever.
The wicked will not keep ruling over the land given to good people, or good people might be tempted to do evil.
LORD, be good to those who are good, to those whose hearts are honest.
But those who turn to crooked ways, the LORD will drive them away with those who do evil. May there be peace in Israel.
